== hev up (no key)
$ hev up
  ✓ no hev layer key: traces are kept in files under $WORK/acc-norg/home/.hev/archive/hev-traces, searched with kit's built-in grep (install ripgrep for speed)
  • no launchd on linux: run `hev d` to capture
  ✓ bundled skills checked for claude, codex
  • no service manager for the dashboard here: run `hev serve`
[exit 0]

== hev serve /api/search
$ sh -c curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1:18431/api/search?q=flaky+deploy&window=7d' | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({"storage":d["storage"],"sessions":[{k:s.get(k) for k in ("id","harness","match_source","snippet") if k in s} for s in d["sessions"]]}, indent=1))'
{
 "storage": {
  "engine": "go",
  "evals": true,
  "mode": "filesystem",
  "note": "Traces are kept in files on this host (Starter Kit, no hev layer key). Search is grep: a session matches when it contains every word you type, so use the exact words you expect. Search by meaning needs a hev layer key.",
  "search": "lexical"
 },
 "sessions": [
  {
   "id": "0199aaaa-bbbb-7ccc-8ddd-eeeeffff0000",
   "harness": "codex",
   "snippet": "The flaky deploy comes from a helm rollout timeout; raising the deadline fixed the retries."
  }
 ]
}
[exit 0]

== redaction delete: the Claude transcript is gone, and a new redaction salt makes the archive redaction upgrade run again
$ sh -c grep -n redact_salt $WORK/acc-norg/home/.hev/config.toml | sed 's/=.*/= <salt>/'
2:redact_salt = <salt>
[exit 0]
$ hev index
indexing claude code transcripts in $WORK/acc-norg/home/.claude/projects

Error: archive migration would permanently remove 1 session(s) whose source transcripts are missing; restore the sources or pass --allow-source-loss to accept the loss
Usage:
  hev index [flags]

Flags:
      --allow-source-loss[=true|false]   let the archive migration permanently remove sessions whose source transcripts are missing
      --dry-run[=true|false]             parse and chunk without writing
      --force[=true|false]               re-index units even if unchanged
  -h, --help[=true|false]                help for index
      --limit int                        stop after this many transcripts
      --namespace string                 Layer namespace (default $HEVLAYER_NAMESPACE or hev-traces)
      --read-side[=true|false]           write only the blocks and sessions namespaces; no chunks, no embedding (use with --force to backfill)
      --root string                      Claude transcript root (default ~/.claude/projects; Codex is always ~/.codex/sessions, dot ~/.dot/traces)
      --summarize[=true|false]           fill missing session summaries using harness titles or local Claude Haiku
      --tier strings                     text, tool_use, tool_result, or all (default text,tool_use)
      --workers int                      concurrent read-side transcripts (1–8; requires --read-side above 1) (default 1)
